name: [Finish] Bloom Glow
nl: Bloom finish: bright areas blooming softly into their surroundings, haloed highlights, gentle contrast lift, photograph style image.

name: [Finish] Chromatic Aberration
nl: Chromatic-aberration finish: red and cyan fringing along high-contrast edges, colour separation growing toward the corners, photograph style image.
negative: perfectly corrected optics, flat clean edges

name: [Finish] Lens Dirt
nl: Dirty-lens finish: dust specks and smears on the front element, veiling haze around light sources, lowered micro-contrast, photograph style image.

name: [Finish] Veiling Flare
nl: Veiling-flare finish: milky wash across the shadows from a light just off frame, lifted blacks, reduced saturation, photograph style image.

name: [Finish] Heavy Vignette
nl: Vignette finish: corners falling into shadow, brightness concentrated at the centre, slight edge softening, photograph style image.

name: [Finish] Anamorphic Streak
nl: Anamorphic finish: horizontal blue streaks off every hot light, oval bokeh, slight edge stretching, photograph style image.

name: [Finish] Shallow Bokeh
nl: Shallow-focus finish: paper-thin plane of focus, creamy blurred surroundings, rounded specular highlights, photograph style image.

name: [Finish] Deep Focus
nl: Deep-focus finish: foreground and distance equally sharp, small aperture clarity, crisp edge detail throughout, photograph style image.
negative: blurred background, shallow depth of field

name: [Finish] Frozen Motion
nl: Frozen-motion finish: fast-shutter crispness, suspended droplets and debris, no trailing blur anywhere, photograph style image.

name: [Finish] Slow Shutter Drag
nl: Slow-shutter finish: trailing motion smears behind moving edges, ghosted overlaps, static parts still sharp, photograph style image.

name: [Finish] Heavy Grain
nl: Heavy-grain finish: coarse clumped silver structure through the mid tones, softened fine detail, gritty texture, photograph style image.

name: [Finish] Clean Digital
nl: Clean-digital finish: noise-free shadows, neutral colour science, controlled micro-contrast, no grain or halation, photograph style image.

name: [Finish] Crushed Blacks
nl: Crushed-black finish: shadows clipped to pure black, punchy separation, no detail in the darks, photograph style image.
negative: lifted milky shadows, flat low contrast

name: [Finish] Lifted Matte
nl: Matte-grade finish: blacks lifted to charcoal, compressed highlights, low saturation, faded print feel, photograph style image.

name: [Finish] High Key
nl: High-key finish: bright shadowless wash, tones pushed toward white, minimal contrast, airy openness, photograph style image.

name: [Finish] Low Key
nl: Low-key finish: most of the frame in shadow, a single sculpted highlight, dense black surround, photograph style image.
negative: bright even fill, airy high-key wash

name: [Finish] Moiré Screen
nl: Moiré finish: overlapping halftone screens beating against each other, interference rosettes, slight colour shimmer, comic style image.

name: [Finish] Dot Gain
nl: Dot-gain finish: halftone dots spreading into each other, darkened mid tones, ink bleeding into absorbent stock, comic style image.
negative: crisp digital print, glossy coated stock

name: [Finish] Uncoated Paper
nl: Uncoated-stock finish: matte fibrous surface, ink sinking slightly, softened edges, muted colour absorption, comic style image.
negative: glossy coated sheen, saturated screen colour

name: [Finish] Foil Stamp
nl: Foil-stamp finish: mirrored metallic areas catching the light, crisp stamped edges, slight debossed depth, graphic style image.
negative: flat matte ink, rough handmade texture

name: [Finish] Emboss Deboss
nl: Emboss finish: raised and recessed areas catching raking light, soft shadow in the depressions, thick paper relief, graphic style image.

name: [Finish] Dust and Scratches
nl: Damaged-print finish: hairline scratches, dust specks, small emulsion nicks, uneven fading at the edges, photograph style image.
negative: pristine clean surface, modern digital clarity

name: [Finish] JPEG Artefacts
nl: Compression finish: blocky 8-pixel artefacts around edges, ringing halos, banded flat areas, muddied fine detail, material style image.

name: [Finish] Upscale Mush
nl: Upscaled finish: over-smoothed surfaces with hallucinated micro-detail, waxy texture, halos along strong edges, material style image.

name: [Finish] Colour Banding
nl: Banding finish: stepped bands across smooth gradients, posterised skies, visible tonal quantisation, material style image.
negative: smooth continuous gradients, deep bit depth

name: [Finish] Screen Door
nl: Screen-door finish: fine dark grid between pixels, RGB subpixel fringing, slight display glow, material style image.

name: [Finish] Ultra Detail
nl: Ultra-detail finish: every fibre, pore and grain resolved, high micro-contrast, crisp edge definition throughout, photograph style image.

name: [Finish] Minimal Detail
nl: Reduced-detail finish: forms simplified to their essential shapes, texture removed, only the largest value steps kept, graphic style image.

name: [Finish] Unfinished Edges
nl: Unfinished finish: resolved focal area fading into blocked-in shapes, raw ground showing at the borders, visible construction, illustration style image.

name: [Finish] Wet Surface Sheen
nl: Wet finish: water beading over every surface, hard specular glints, mirrored reflections in the flats, darkened saturated colour, photograph style image.
